Description: S3 buckets found without Key Management Service (KMS) Server-Side Encryption (SSE). SSE is used to protect data at rest, and encryption with S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) is enabled by default. However, SSE-KMS provides additional security controls and key management.

Recommendation.Text: S3 buckets should be encrypted at rest using KMS keys (SSE-KMS or DSSE-KMS).
